articles.title: Tether posts $1.5 billion operating profit in Q2 as reserve buffer falls by half
articles.snippet: The world’s largest stablecoin issuer added 14 metric tons of gold and about 1,800 bitcoin to its reserves during the second quarter.

articles.title: Circle secures New York trust charter as crypto regulatory push accelerates
articles.snippet: The approval lets the USDC issuer offer fiduciary and custody services under New York banking law.

articles.title: New York sues Kalshi, alleges it offers a gambling platform 'plain and simple'
articles.snippet: The suit wants to bar the company from operating what it says is an unlicensed gambling business and seeks financial redress.

articles.title: CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
articles.snippet: CME CEO Terry Duffy said a court battle over whether perpetual futures are swaps or futures could eventually affect how the IRS taxes the contracts. Independent legal experts say the issue remains unresolved.

articles.title: Citadel buys bulk of Situational Awareness stock portfolio after AI rout: Reports
articles.snippet: Situational Awareness retained about $10 billion in assets, including its Anthropic stake, after reportedly selling leveraged public stock positions to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.
